# DevExpress.Utils NuGet Package

The **DevExpress.Utils** package contains shared WinForms UI infrastructure used by DevExpress controls: the skinning/theming engine, low-level GDI+/Direct2D painting helpers, common editor/panel base controls, popup menus, drag-and-drop, accessibility (UI Automation).

When you use related DevExpress WinForms UI Controls, this package is installed automatically as a transitive dependency. 

## Key Features

* Skins and Themes: the shared appearance layer that supports rendering any control with DevExpress skins, Office-style themes, and flat or 3D styles.
* Shared Painting Infrastructure: the low-level drawing abstraction reused by DevExpress controls.
* Common Editor and Panel Controls: shared base panel/group/splitter controls.
* Popup Menus and Drag-and-Drop: shared drop-down menu and drag-and-drop infrastructure used by Toolbars/Menus, Ribbon, and Data Editors.
* Accessibility and HiDPI Support: UI Automation and DPI-scaling utilities used across all desktop controls.

## Evaluation Period, Pricing Options, and Licensing Terms

Whether you own a license or want to start a 30-day evaluation, download and register your DevExpress license key. To obtain the key, sign in to the [DevExpress Download Manager](https://www.devexpress.com/ClientCenter/DownloadManager/) with your existing DevExpress.com account or create a free account. For instructions on key registration, see [License Key for DevExpress Products](https://www.devexpress.com/go/Licensing_Documentation.aspx).

If you purchase a license after evaluating a product, you need to re-register your updated DevExpress license key to remove evaluation warnings and messages.
